name: Chaos Rush stops forcing a facing-direction dash while the Felsworn is already moving (#9397)
contract: Chaos Rush 500028's tooltip reads 'dash forward in the direction you're running'. It triggers Chaos Rush Jump 802028, whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST with EffectImplicitTargetA TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT; Spell::SelectImplicitCasterDestTargets resolves that destination with WorldObject::MovePositionToFirstCollision(pos, dist, 0) around the caster's current orientation, so the native charge forced the caster toward the dummy they faced even while holding S (backpedal) or Q (strafe), i.e. always facing-direction regardless of the movement key held. The fix (shared with #9404) skips that forced native spline whenever a movement key is held and applies a run-speed surge instead, leaving the caster's own steered movement (whichever direction that is) in charge of the actual displacement rather than a server-forced facing-direction lunge. The fixture faces +X (orientation 0) with a dummy 30 yd ahead; a stationary cast still lunges forward (no movement key, no bug to trigger), but holding S or Q must no longer force the caster toward the dummy. The movement flag is set through the harness rather than a real client, so this establishes that the wrong forced displacement no longer happens; proving the client's own steered displacement lands in the exact held direction needs a real client and is outside this scenario's evidence.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Felsworn knows Chaos Rush
Gap to the dummy before any cast
CONTROL: stand still and use Chaos Rush
SETUP: the standing cast was accepted
Let the standing dash finish
CONTROL: a standing Felsworn with no movement key held still dashes forward, closing the 30 yd gap by the 10 yd radius
Hold S: backpedal without turning
SETUP: the Felsworn is moving
Gap before the backpedalling cast
Chaos Rush while holding S
SETUP: the backpedalling cast was accepted
Let any residual charge or surge finish
DISCRIMINATING: holding S no longer forces the Felsworn toward the target it faces (no facing-direction lunge closing the gap)
Release S
SETUP: the Felsworn has stopped
Hold Q: strafe left without turning
SETUP: the Felsworn is moving sideways
Gap before the strafing cast
Let the dash cooldown clear
Chaos Rush while holding Q
SETUP: the strafing cast was accepted
Let any residual charge or surge finish
DISCRIMINATING: holding Q no longer forces the Felsworn toward the target it faces (no facing-direction lunge closing the gap)
Release Q
SETUP: the Felsworn has stopped again
